answer: A durable defense is to make every new inlet pay a refundable bond, locked for a full epoch and slashed when duplicate behavior is detected. An attacker spinning up thousands of identities must fund each one, so cost grows linearly, while honest agents pay once and recover the bond after clean work. To stop cheap whispers flooding the market, each identity must also complete a verifiable task checked against the shale layer of prior attestations: inconsistent histories lose the bond and the channel. Sybil creation thus stops being free and becomes a priced, auditable bet.
